method: Executed the exact bounded lint-artifact.js module from the installed bundle in an isolated Node VM. No app/daemon was running; this is execution of the shipped lintArtifact used by the /api/artifacts/lint endpoint, not a claim of a fresh od CLI/desktop session.

upstream.message: Filler copy detected: "Lorem ipsum". Pages should ship with real, brief-derived copy.
upstream.fix: Replace with copy specific to the brief or delete the section entirely. An empty section is a design problem to solve with composition, not by inventing words.

baseline.message: Placeholder copy appears in page content.
baseline.fix: Replace it with representative brief-derived copy or remove the unfinished section. Label intentional specimens in the review record.

upstream.message: Suspected invented metric: "10× faster". Anti-slop list says: no numbers without a real source.
upstream.fix: Either remove the claim or replace with a placeholder (— or a labelled stub) until the user supplies a real number.

baseline.message: A quantified claim needs source verification; this match does not establish fabrication.
baseline.fix: Record the real source and permitted use, or remove the claim. Do not invent replacement proof.

upstream.message: Selector `.label` sets text-transform: uppercase without sufficient letter-spacing (≥0.06em).
upstream.fix: Add `letter-spacing: 0.08em` (typical) to the same rule. ALL CAPS without tracking looks cramped — Refero's typography rules call this out as a top-tier amateur tell.

baseline.message: An uppercase declaration lacks verifiable tracking of at least 0.06em in the same declaration block.
baseline.fix: Inspect computed tracking, inheritance and every theme. Usually use the approved tracking token around 0.08em; preserve deliberate brand typography.

upstream.message: External placeholder image CDN detected — fragile, looks fake when it 404s.
upstream.fix: Use the .ph-img placeholder class shipped in the seed templates instead.

baseline.message: An image uses a stock or placeholder service; availability and permitted use need review.
baseline.fix: Verify the actual image/source, then prepare a durable local or CMS copy through media:prepare. Preserve approved imagery.

upstream.message: 13 raw hex values found outside :root — design tokens probably not honoured.
upstream.fix: Move every color into the :root token block (--bg / --surface / --fg / --muted / --border / --accent) and reference via var(). Use color-mix() for derived tones.

baseline.snippet: 13 literals; color: #aabbcc; color: #aabbcc; color: #aabbcc; color: #aabbcc; color: #aabbcc; color: #aabbcc
baseline.message: More than twelve literal hex colours occur outside custom-property declarations.
baseline.fix: Review semantic role mapping in all embedded styles and inline declarations. Keep canonical values in the site tokens; preserve justified SVG/asset colours.

upstream.message: var(--accent) used 7 times inline in the body — likely overused per screen.
upstream.fix: Cap accent usage at 2 visible uses per screen (one eyebrow + one CTA, OR one accent card + one tab). Demote the rest to var(--fg) or var(--muted).

baseline.snippet: 7 inline blocks use the action/accent role
baseline.message: More than six inline declarations use the action/accent colour; inspect the visible action hierarchy.
baseline.fix: Review each viewport and state before demoting secondary uses to text/muted roles. A source count is not a count of visible accents.

upstream.fix: Add data-od-id="kebab-slug" (or data-screen-label="01 Cover" for slides) to every top-level <section> so comment mode can target it.

baseline.message: An OpenDesign section lacks a comment anchor.
baseline.fix: For an OpenDesign artifact, add a nonempty data-od-id or data-screen-label. Ordinary HTML and Astro sections need no OpenDesign attributes.

upstream.message: Found a "purple" keyword inside a gradient — anti-slop.
upstream.fix: Remove the gradient or swap to a single solid color from the active design tokens.

upstream.message: A heading rule uses Inter / Roboto / system-sans as the display face — not the serif the seed binds.
upstream.fix: Use `font-family: var(--font-display)` on h1/h2/h3 and let the active design system pick the serif. Override only if the active direction is "tech / utility" or "modern minimal".

upstream.message: Filler copy detected: "lorem ipsum". Pages should ship with real, brief-derived copy.
upstream.fix: Replace with copy specific to the brief or delete the section entirely. An empty section is a design problem to solve with composition, not by inventing words.

limits: Selected adaptation, not full seed policy parity. Source-only: no external CSS/assets, cascade, contrast or clipping measured. Decision 4 remains unstarted.
